title: BigBalls 💪🏽🍒 Program: Beginner/Novice Full-Body
desc:
Most scientifically, statistically, mathematically, judiciously, veridically, systematically, and anecdotally proven weightlifting program 💯 to increase testicular size! Yoked and chaddy results only. 

Read the PDF dork: https://docs.google.com/document/d/16Z9Yj4xyU6OkPhibyXNZdrcaYgO8zTb5ds4o1hD1cIU/edit

ss.note:
Barbell Squats, Unilateral Squats, Goblet Squats etc. are all interchangeable, choose one that doesn’t hurt your lower back or knees as much. 

Form: https://youtu.be/fEuYM-miK5U?si=bbIrw-O93XAbPGZY
Lean forward and grab the top of the handle, shifting tricep dominance to chest, as we’re attempting to replace bodyweight dips for chest growth here. Normal dips are preferred if physically able.
Do the weakest arm first, since unilateral exercises should only log the weaker arm. The dominant arm should wait till the weaker can hit the end of the rep-range before changing weight.

Personal Recommendation is to use a Shoulder-Width Neutral Grip.

Any attachment is interchangeable that works for YOU.
Any grip that feels natural to YOU (rope, curl-bar, straight-bar etc.) is interchangeable.

ex.note: Machine Crunch variant preferred if available. Otherwise, bodyweight Sit-Ups progressing to weighted Sit-Ups is just as good and has the same level of progression overload potential.

ss.note:
Smith Machine Press and Barbell Bench Press are interchangeable. However, recommend sticking with dumbbells for now. 

Form: https://youtube.com/shorts/1V3vpcaxRYQ?si=YvnyLh_4C7HAuokO

All hammer curl-style variations such as standing, seated, preacher etc. is fine. 

Reverse & Pinwheel curls too.

Personal recommendation: https://youtube.com/shorts/gUQfcN5DNRA?si=CqbMnxVveW3hhuZJ

https://repfitness.com/products/pro-series-neutral-grip-lat-bar

Picture of the grip^ 

Any other grip that feels natural to YOU is interchangeable and will target your lats slightly differently.
Although the beginner program is flexible in terms of how many sets you want to do and hard you want to push yourself. One set is more than enough. Push to two if you want/can to build capacity.

Standing OHP and Machine Shoulder Press variants are interchangeable.

Only do this movement if you don’t feel any pain. If you do, stop and talk to a doctor to discuss alternatives. Check PDF.
Although the beginner program is flexible in terms of how many sets you want to do and hard you want to push yourself. One set is more than enough. Push to two if you want/can to build capacity.

ex.note:
1st stage: Build up to 2 minutes over time and do not by any means push yourself to sit through any pain. 

Progression explanation after 1st stage: https://youtu.be/zCNCVR5Xd3Y?si=RuffFlwXdVj78BHr

Oblique Crunch Hyperextensions variant is interchangeable.

Going to failure is optional for women, instead just do a few weighted reps to stretch and strengthen the muscle instead, no focus on size.

ss.note:
Trickiest exercise to get down in terms of form, try your best and improve over time. SLDL’s are interchangeable here, not the conventional DL.
 
Form: https://youtu.be/BF-vvMGP8Y0?si=WlkU_uMGIB3e93Dn
Standing calf raises or any other variant where your legs are lengthened/straight, is preferred if available.

Recommendation is to start with dumbbells then transition to the Smith Machine. Machine Press & Barbell variants interchangeable if available.

Set bench angle to whatever is most comfortable.
Any bicep curl movement is interchangeable that targets the Biceps Brachii. Preacher Curls, Machine Preacher Curls, Supinated Dumbbell Curls standing or seated etc.
Do the weakest arm first, since unilateral exercises should only log the weaker arm. The dominant arm should wait till the weaker can hit the end of the rep-range before changing weight.

ex.note: Hanging Leg Raises or Captains Chair Leg Raises preferred if available.
